# HexPiece 3.7.1

Your Phoenix notes on landing, the ground and the tail. **Not tested in game yet:** the build and all 13 test suites pass, and every
new pose was rendered in previews.

## The tail streams out straight in flight
Your words: "also when flying the tails should go straight".
The three gold tail streamers no longer hang and curl while flying. They trail out straight behind the phoenix, the middle one
straight back and the outer two fanning a little to each side, with a slow wave running down them. Standing on the ground, they
lie straight back along the ground behind it.

## Landing, standing and walking
Your words: "I also want a landing animation and being on ground/walk animation, not just flying".
- **Landing:** when you drop to within about 3.5 blocks of the ground, the phoenix brakes. It rears back, flares its wings high and
  forward, and reaches its claws toward the ground. On touchdown its body dips, its wings sweep down to catch the ground and then
  fold, and a ring of blue fire runs out over the ground round its claws.
- **Standing:** on the ground the phoenix stands on its claws with its wings folded at its sides like a cloak. Now and then it opens
  them a little to settle its feathers, and it looks around.
- **Walking:** walking on the ground, it steps on its claws one foot after the other. Its body bobs and rolls with each step, its
  neck pumps forward and back like a bird's, and its folded wings bounce slightly.
- Creative flight still works as before: landing on the ground stops flying, and double-tapping jump takes off again.
